However, for Lin Yuan, this was naturally not a big deal. He didn’t fully activate the might of this supreme weapon, just trying it out to see if it felt right in his hands.

Rustle, rustle.

One after another, black spatial rifts appeared. Everywhere they touched, everything was annihilated.

…

In the distance.

...

A six-armed figure looked on with curiosity, not knowing what Lin Yuan was up to.

As The Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the six-armed figure had an inkling that something was amiss with Lin Yuan’s arrival, but couldn’t pinpoint exactly what.

Until—

Lin Yuan, holding a pitch-black iron staff, casually swung it, tearing a black rift tens of thousands of miles long.

This particular black rift set the six-armed figure’s heart trembling and mind fogging.

Compared to the Main Universe, the space within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was much more stable.

To tear space within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, one would at least need the strength of the Ninth Stage Peak.

But even at the Ninth Stage Peak, the number of Spatial Layers torn in an instant would only be up to several hundreds of thousands at most.

Even those special Ninth-Stage beings from the Myriad Heavy Realm, at their full strength, wouldn’t exceed this number when tearing through the Spatial Layers.

Level Ten and Level Eleven Powerhouses were almost the same; if they were in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the number of Spatial Layers they could tear in an instant wouldn’t exceed ten million.

However, the spat of that iron staff from Lin Yuan had caused black spatial rifts to form.

Normally, spatial rifts would mostly appear grey-hued; black rifts indicated that one was close to tearing through all the Spatial Layers.

In other words, Lin Yuan’s strike was so powerful that it could very well have pierced through the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

How could the six-armed figure not tremble at heart? The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was opened by Emperor Xuanhuang himself; even if the internal defenses were not as robust as the external, piercing through the realm was no easy feat.

At least the Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings are far from capable of it, even with a supreme weapon in hand. It’s very difficult to tear the Spatial Layers to this extent instantaneously.

Just Lin Yuan?

The six-armed figure watched Lin Yuan nonchalantly tear through rifts tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands of miles long, and its heart violently trembled.

“Master… how could he demonstrate such a level of power with a supreme weapon…”

The six-armed figure could hardly believe it. He also saw that Lin Yuan’s ability to open the black spatial rifts originated from that iron staff supreme weapon in his hand.

But to activate a supreme weapon, one needed sufficient understanding of space-time, especially since Lin Yuan had yet to refine those supreme weapons. Even if he could activate them, the power he could demonstrate would be extremely limited.

But Lin Yuan?

How did he manage to do it?

The six-armed figure actually had a guess in his heart, which was that Lin Yuan’s comprehension of space-time was very high, perhaps reaching the twelfth level? But this young master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was only at the tenth level!

…

High above the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan casually swung the pitch-black iron staff, feeling the power it exerted.

“With my current strength, at full power, plus initial refinement of this supreme weapon, I can create an Eternal Spatial Rift within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The condition for creating an Eternal Spatial Rift was to tear through all Spatial Layers.

Currently, with a supreme weapon in Lin Yuan’s hand, even without initial refinement, he could release a strength of over a thousand battles. The number of Spatial Layers in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was far fewer than in the Main Universe, hence he could hope to tear it open completely.

Of course, Lin Yuan could only achieve this feat within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. In the Main Universe, to create an Eternal Spatial Rift would require a strength capable of million battle might.

That was the threshold strength of the twelfth level.

Only with such strength could one tear through all the Spatial Layers of the Main Universe.

…

“This iron staff, it still doesn’t suit me.”

After trying for a while, Lin Yuan gave up the idea of refining the iron staff.

The power of the staff was indeed great, but it was different from Lin Yuan’s fighting style.

Moreover, in the Two-dimensional World, in front of the Powerhouses of the Myriad Clans, Lin Yuan had used this supreme weapon several times.

If he now chose to refine this pitch-black iron staff, as soon as he used it in the outside world, it would surely be recognized by the Powerhouses of the Starry Sky Races.

The conclusion would then be drawn—

That human evolver named ‘Xueyu’ from the Two-dimensional World, was Lin Yuan.

Supreme weapons are not unique, but there are only so many in number, and there are few choices for staff-shaped supreme weapons.

…

Next.

Lin Yuan continued to try out the other thirty-one supreme weapons.

Ultimately, for offensive supreme weapons, he chose a silver-white battle saber.

This silver-white battle saber embodied a complete Space Great Tao, which is Space Great Tao, not Space Rules. With one slash, its sharpness reached an extreme.

As for defense, regarding physical defense, Lin Yuan chose a golden armor, one of the finest physical defensive weapons among the thirty-two supreme weapons.

And for soul defense, Lin Yuan’s choices were very limited, because among the thirty-two supreme weapons, there was only one that was a supreme weapon for soul defense.

It was a deep cyan bead.

…

Three supreme weapons, one offensive and two defensive.

Fully armed to the teeth, other Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings would find it extremely difficult to obtain one supreme weapon bestowed by their tribes, yet Lin Yuan was equipped with three at once.

“What a pity, with my understanding of space-time, even if I could refine the supreme weapons quickly, the energy needed to activate them dictates that I can hold at most three…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

If possible, he naturally wanted to refine all the supreme weapons.

But it was unrealistic, not being a supreme being, the burden of activating supreme weapons was great. Even if Lin Yuan stepped into the eleventh level, it was not possible to activate too many supreme weapons at once.

“This will be the three.”

“Time to start refining them.”

Lin Yuan once again appeared at the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, picked up the silver-white battle saber, and his will began to penetrate as he quickly started the refining process.

Refining a supreme weapon was no simple matter; normally, for Level Eleven Perfect beings to initially refine a supreme weapon, it would take thousands to tens of thousands of years.

Lin Yuan, however, was much faster, able to refine one in just a few years at most.
